name: Rivet Icons
about: Rivet Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 210 icons designed by Indiana University. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under BSD 3-Clause.

faqs.q: Are Rivet Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 210 Rivet Icons are open source under the BSD 3-Clause license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the BSD 3-Clause terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Rivet Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Rivet Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 210 icons in the Rivet Icons set, designed by Indiana University. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Rivet Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Rivet Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
